units.translation: ⟦1⟧: after he has seen the revenge, which is as good as accomplished, he concerns himself no further with it; therefore not ⟦2⟧. ⟦3⟧ (M) is explained in the scholia with ⟦4⟧, thus derived from ⟦5⟧ 'yoke' (⟦6⟧, ⟦7⟧); but there is no evidence for such an adjective. Musgrave and Hermann write ⟦8⟧ (= ⟦9⟧ Hom.), which is also better insofar as the different images do not mix.
⟦1⟧ as ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧', and already Theogn. 620 (Weckl.) ⟦4⟧. So the waves are already closing over him.
for we are not able to surmount the crest of the wave
for we have not outrun the crest of poverty
⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧; to ⟦4⟧, which accompanied him throughout his life and seemed permanent.
⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧, explained by the ancients with ⟦3⟧; also the ⟦4⟧ stands in relation to this.
